title: SECTION C: LANGUAGE STRUCTURES AND CONVENTIONS
instructions: Answer the language questions. Use Text A and follow each instruction carefully.

questions.question: Rewrite the following sentence in the passive voice: 'The plant now provides enough electricity to power the town's water pumps and irrigation systems.' (paragraph 4)
memo: Enough electricity to power the town's water pumps and irrigation systems is now provided by the plant.

questions.question: Explain the meaning of the word 'beacon' as used in paragraph 1.
memo: A beacon is a guiding light or symbol of hope; here it means Loxton is a symbol of hope for renewable energy.

questions.question: Why is the apostrophe used in the word 'town's' in paragraph 4?
memo: It shows possession, meaning the town owns the primary school.

questions.question: Combine the following sentences into one sentence using 'because': 'The cooperative faces challenges. The cost of battery storage is high.' (paragraph 6)
memo: The cooperative faces challenges because the cost of battery storage is high.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech in the phrase 'the earth cracks under the weight of drought' (paragraph 1) and explain its effect.
memo: Personification; it gives the earth human qualities, emphasising the severity of the drought.

questions.question: Change the following sentence to reported speech: 'We had to adapt or die,' says Pieter van der Merwe. (paragraph 3)
memo: Pieter van der Merwe says that they had to adapt or die.

questions.question: Rewrite the following sentence in a more formal register: 'The future looked bleak.' (paragraph 2)
memo: The future appeared to be without hope.

questions.question: Explain the function of the commas in the sentence: 'Water pumping costs have dropped by 60%, and the cooperative has been able to sell excess electricity back to the national grid, generating an income that funds local schools and clinics.' (paragraph 4)
memo: The first comma separates two independent clauses joined by 'and'; the second comma introduces a participial phrase.

questions.question: Rewrite the following sentence in the negative form: 'The cooperative has been able to sell excess electricity back to the national grid.' (paragraph 4)
memo: The cooperative has not been able to sell excess electricity back to the national grid.

questions.question: What is the connotation of the word 'bleak' in paragraph 2?
memo: It has a negative connotation, suggesting hopelessness and despair.
